rules.name: Runtime model honesty
rules.description: Flag fabricated inference events, probabilities, latency, provider attribution, confidence values or success claims. Model trace entries must come from a real call or be marked skipped/error. Hard-coded, random or default confidence shown as a calibrated probability is a violation. User-facing probabilities may only come from the measurement-based probe posterior or a cited labelled-set evaluation.

rules.name: Required human confirmation
rules.description: The solver, probe and explain paths must not accept an unreviewed extraction: userConfirmed === true and validateGraph must pass server-side. Flag any removal or weakening of this gate, or client code that sets userConfirmed without an explicit user action. Editing a confirmed graph must invalidate the confirmation and clear stale solve/probe/explain results.

rules.name: Math correctness
rules.description: The local MNA solver (solveDC) is the sole authority for voltages, currents and resistances. Flag any LLM-computed or LLM-supplied number used as a solved value. LLM explanations (src/lib/explain) must be grounded in verified solver values and must not introduce numbers absent from solver output. Solver changes need tests incl. the 10k/10k divider at 5 V = 2.5 V and malformed/floating-graph errors.

rules.name: Safe model routing
rules.description: Routing is Groq-first with Gemini fallback; Jev routing must be real (not simulated) and respect free-tier pacing and rate limits. Provider failures must surface honestly with a manual recovery path, never be masked or reported as success. Vision models read images; Jev never receives pixels. Must match docs/MODEL_ACCESS.md.

rules.name: Electrical safety scope
rules.description: Scope is low-voltage DC resistive circuits only. Flag claims of fault certainty (measurements are hypotheses), advice to measure resistance on an energized circuit, advice to power a circuit whose candidate topology shorts the supply, mains/high-voltage/high-energy guidance, or removal of existing SAFETY text.

rules.name: API compatibility
rules.description: /api/extract, /api/solve, /api/probe and /api/explain request/response shapes must match docs/API_CONTRACT.md and src/lib/circuit/types.ts (schemaVersion 1, kinds resistor|dc_voltage, groundNode 'GND', SI units). Flag contract changes without a matching API_CONTRACT.md update and tests.

rules.name: Release integrity
rules.description: Flag fake demos, claims exceeding the implementation or evidence (README, docs, UI copy, PR text), hidden paid-model escalation (jev-1.13 paid tier, OpenAI/Anthropic or other paid APIs, Gemini billing, raised spend limits) without linked owner approval, secrets exposed to the client (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) or logged, and undocumented production database migrations.

rules.name: Hosting
rules.description: Anbaric is the primary deployment target and Vercel the fallback. Flag hosting or deployment config changes that lack real deployment evidence (URL, logs or check output) or that silently switch the primary target.
